subject: Important Update Regarding Your Recent Purchase
body: Dear Customer, We would like to inform you that there has been a delay in processing your recent order due to high demand. Rest assured, our team is working diligently to fulfill your order as soon as possible. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your patience. If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to contact our customer support team. Thank you for choosing our services.
